entities.summary: Raymond Laurent Vincent Narac is a French racing driver who last competed for Les Deux Arbres in the JS P4 class of the Ligier European Series. He is best known for founding IMSA Performance, where he racked up consecutive ELMS titles and a pair of 24 Hours of Le Mans class wins.
